question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.2**
solution:
The correct answer is **option 3) i.e. 'stuck'.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given passage the **subject of this line is '****A giant plane****'**, which was forced to crash land because its landing gear was unable to move.
 
• Here, in the given fill-in-the-blank, **the most appropriate word is ‘stuck'.**
 
• **Stuck:** unable to move, or set in a particular position, place, or way of thinking.
 
• **Example**:
 
 
• *I was **stuck** in the lift for one hour due to an accidental power cut in our office.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, **we find that the correct answer is Option 3.**

 

**Correct Sentence:**__ ..*.**when its landing gear got __**stuck.**__*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the words given in the options:

 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Glued
 to join things together using glue

 to take hold of something, especially something that is moving through the air
